title: Customs Amendment (Prohibition of Certain Coal Exports) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prohibit exports of coal mined in specified water catchment areas within Wyong Shire by adding restrictions to the Customs Act.
The initial prohibition would use the area identified by Wyong Shire Council as Water Catchment Valleys and District on 18 March 2013.
It would also let the Minister extend export prohibitions to other designated areas through legislative instruments, with the amendments applying prospectively rather than retrospectively.
changes: An export prohibition would cover coal originating from the defined Wyong catchment area.
The Minister would gain power to designate additional areas for coal export prohibitions.
summary.affected: Exporters of coal mined in the specified Wyong Shire area or other areas designated by the Minister are affected.
